title: Divine.DAO (Series 7) — Ghats of Governance
summary: An agent-managed, human-governed DAO cell set on Dashashwamedh Ghat, Varanasi. Five stone-and-marble pavilions rise above the Ganges at dawn aarti: charter carved in public, agents synthesizing evidence, humans holding every final vote.

buildings.name: Charter Mandapam
buildings.use: Public display of the DAO charter, contribution model and measurable outcomes

buildings.name: Stone Ledger Gallery
buildings.use: Inscribed outcome plaques and contribution records

districts.real_anchor: Ganges riverbank below the ghat steps

buildings.name: Evidence Archive Vault
buildings.use: Storage of monitored developments and summaries

districts.real_anchor: Upper ghat platform overlooking the aarti stage

buildings.name: Proposal Sabha
buildings.use: Open forum where agent-drafted proposals are debated by people

buildings.name: Deliberation Veranda
buildings.use: Shaded debate and amendment discussion space

props: stack of proposal drafts on reed paper

districts.real_anchor: Ghat-side lane connecting to Godowlia crossing

buildings.name: Operations Chabutara
buildings.use: Task routing and working-group coordination hub

buildings.name: Collaborators' Rest House
buildings.use: Lodging and meeting for scouted experts and working groups

districts.real_anchor: Topmost terrace above the Ganges rooftop line

buildings.name: Progress Jharokha
buildings.use: Terrace observatory tracking progress against charter outcomes

court.name: Sabha of the Rising Aarti
court.style: Open-air river court on the ghat steps
court.why_here: Dawn aarti makes the divine public and daily; here every final vote stays a human act, taken together at first light above the Ganges.

quests.title: Inscribe the Charter
steps: Read the charter pillar in the Reading Court
Copy the reserved-for-humans list onto a reed-paper draft
Carry the draft to the Proposal Sabha for human debate
Witness the vote chest remain sealed until humans vote

quests.title: Evidence at First Light
steps: Collect the morning summaries from the Monitoring Desk
Triage sources at the Source Triage Bench
Hand verified summaries to the Progress Tracker
Log one measurable outcome on the milestone tracker

quests.title: The Scout's Round
steps: Take a task chit from the Routing Board
Deliver a courier basket down the ghat lane
Collect collaborator names with the Collaborator Scout
File the findings in the Evidence Archive Vault

quests.title: Draft, Never Enact
steps: Watch the Proposal & Grant Drafter prepare a proposal draft
Join debate on the Deliberation Veranda
Confirm the drafter holds no enactment key
Record the outcome in the Stone Ledger Gallery

quests.title: Count the Aarti Lamps
steps: Climp to the Dawn Watch Terrace before sunrise
Count lit outcome lamps against the milestone tracker
Carry the progress count to the Proposal Sabha
Post the count beside the draft proposals for the next human vote
